description:
Dues is a payment platform, so this server has people's money in it. Most of these rules exist to keep that from going wrong. Breaking one gets you a warning; breaking 5, 6, 7 or 8 does not.

**1.** Be civil. No harassment, hate speech, slurs, or personal attacks.

**2.** No spam, mass mentions, or unsolicited DMs.

**3.** No advertising or recruiting for other servers, stores, or services.

**4.** Support goes in <#1541818254740422748>. Include your order email or order id.

**5.** Never post card numbers, bot tokens, API keys, or passwords. Not even in a ticket.

**6.** Staff never DM you first. Anyone who DMs you asking for payment, tokens, or passwords is a scammer. Report it in <#1541818254740422748>.

**7.** No impersonating Dues staff, sellers, or other members.

**8.** Do not leak or resell content you bought through a Dues store.

**9.** Open a ticket in <#1541818254740422748> before you go to your bank. A chargeback is not a refund route - it costs the seller a fee on top of the money and takes weeks to resolve. Asking us is faster.

**10.** Sellers: deliver what your listing promises, and honour your own refund policy.

**11.** Follow Discord's Terms of Service. Nothing illegal, no NSFW.

**12.** Staff decisions are final. Raise disputes in <#1541818254740422748>, not in public.

Official links are in <#1541819865625657384> and nowhere else. If you found a "Dues" link somewhere else, it is not ours.
